restaurant_name: Daytime smile clinic สาขาเชียงใหม่
text: The service was good, but before deciding, you should really understand your own teeth. Ask for details carefully and choose what's best for you. Because in my case, I had some lower teeth extracted, but not the upper ones. Transferring my case to another clinic would be difficult. Pulling the lower teeth risks them shifting, and extracting the upper teeth to make them even also risks it. In the end, I went to three different clinics, and they all said the same thing: that's the way it should be, and I should get dentures after treatment because it's a difficult case. And since the teeth have already been extracted, what can I do next? They gave me a form to sign, one clause stating I wouldn't take legal action against the clinic if they caused me any damage. Think carefully, think again. That's all. Goodbye. The staff were very helpful and impressive, but... 🙂

text:
*Things to Read Before Receiving Treatment*
So you don't have to go through what we did (I felt so disappointed).
The story is, I had braces done elsewhere, and my teeth were actually already quite straight. Then I moved to Chiang Mai and wanted to finish my orthodontic treatment, so I contacted them through their page, made an appointment to see the doctor, and discuss the orthodontic treatment plan.
⛔ On April 28, 2025, I met Dr. Ice (the doctor was very helpful). The doctor said that my teeth could start treatment at the clinic, meaning they would remove the braces from the old clinic (okay, understood). I had a lot of cavities; 5 teeth needed fillings, and I also needed scaling and crowns (I was okay with this). After talking to the doctor, I went to talk to the staff at the counter to calculate the expenses I needed to prepare. This staff member took my case form from the doctor.
♦️The 5 teeth that needed fillings cost a total of 💰8,101💰 (a lot, right?), but I was okay with it and would do it gradually.
♦️Crown cost another 💰13,000💰 (done after braces are finished)
⛔That day we removed the braces and cleaned off the glue, costing 💰2,000💰. We bought the 299 baht braces package (the staff only informed us of what was included in this package and that there would be a 10% discount if we had our mouth cleaned there). ♦️They didn't mention that we couldn't use our Gold Card benefits at other clinics.
In total, we paid 💰2,299💰 that day.
#Before the second appointment, we went for scaling and a filling at a clinic that accepts Gold Card benefits (to reduce costs). So now we only have 4 teeth left to fill.
⛔9/05/68 Same staff member At the registration counter, I informed them I needed two fillings, and everything went smoothly. After the fillings were done, I went to pay.
💰3,780💰 10% discount
⛔15/05/68 There was a *different* employee (this person didn't know the details of my treatment and didn't even read my medical history). She was a bit overweight, heavier than all the other employees in the clinic. When I arrived, I informed them I had an appointment for fillings. (I don't know what happened, but she suddenly asked if this was the person who used the gold card.) The other employees there looked confused, and I didn't know what to say. So I replied that I had already used my gold card to get one filling done, and today I was here to get the remaining one. Then she went on a long rant, saying that I couldn't get fillings done elsewhere because it wouldn't be in line with the doctor's treatment guidelines. #But I haven't even had my braces put on yet!🙄 What is this??
#Her words were like she was a partner in the clinic. She was being overly dramatic, and then she told me I couldn't get the freebies from the 299 baht braces promotion (because I used my gold card elsewhere). But when I booked the promotion, nobody mentioned this condition. I was only informed that there was a 10% discount on oral cleaning here.
*I was starting to get annoyed 🙄 Last time I had two fillings here, no staff member said anything.

♦️Finally, I went up to get another filling, then came down to pay at the counter 💰1,200💰 with the 10% discount.

Then we immediately found a new clinic. I was very disappointed with this staff member. You weren't the one handling the case, you didn't even know the customer's information. You just kept talking and talking and talking. You didn't ask me if anyone had informed me that I couldn't use my government health insurance from another clinic (I was so angry). If you don't understand the customer, you should at least ask other colleagues about the case, because you weren't the one handling the case from the beginning.
⚠️Initially, the doctor told me that I needed to continue orthodontic treatment for another 20 months.⚠️

But now, I've switched to another clinic because of this staff member. Even though other clinics don't have the 299 baht promotion, I can still afford it.
